items.description: Mecanismo provider-agnóstico de carregamento (Money In) da Banzami Wallet: dinheiro real entra através de pelo menos um provider de funding aprovado, sobre a abstração AcquirerProvider (core/acquiring). acceptanceCriteria: State machine: all invalid transitions rejected (PASS)
Callback idempotency: duplicate provider_event_id rejected at DB level (PASS)
Reconcile idempotency: double-reconcile produces single posting (PASS)
Callback alone does not credit wallet (PASS — INV-WAL-004-1)
Settled session has exactly one ledger posting (PASS — INV-WAL-004-2)
Reversal creates offset posting and preserves original (PASS — INV-WAL-004-4)
Expired sessions cannot transition to Settled (PASS — INV-WAL-004-5)

evidence: provider_callbacks_event_unique UNIQUE constraint — idempotency at data layer
LedgerEngine.reverse() — reversal preserves original posting immutably
blockingIssues: FUNDING_PROVIDER_REQUIRED: nenhum provider de funding operacional em produção. EMIS/Multicaixa Express, banco parceiro (BANK-001) ou outro provider licenciado pode satisfazer esta capacidade — corre com provider SIMULATED em testes.

invariants.name: External callback alone never changes wallet balance
invariants.rule: Receiving a provider callback advances session state but creates zero ledger entries. The wallet balance is unchanged until reconcile() creates a verified ledger posting.

invariants.name: Each settled session maps to exactly one ledger posting
invariants.rule: A SETTLED session has exactly one ledger_posting_id. The idempotency key funding-settle-{session_id} prevents duplicate postings even under retries.

invariants.name: Duplicate provider callbacks cannot duplicate the credit
invariants.rule: UNIQUE(provider, provider_event_id) in provider_callbacks rejects duplicate callbacks at the data layer. FundingEngine maps constraint violations to DuplicateCallback.

invariants.name: Reversal preserves immutable audit history
invariants.rule: Reversal creates a new offset ledger posting (reversal_posting_id). The original posting remains immutable. Both are preserved. reversed_at and failure_reason are recorded.

invariants.name: Pending and reconciling sessions are never spendable
invariants.rule: Only SETTLED sessions have a ledger_posting_id with a credit. EXPIRED sessions reject all further transitions. Non-SETTLED sessions contribute zero to wallet balance.
